Working at a job that I hate for the rest of my life and dying right before I get to retire.

I almost went that route. I was a professional working in high-tech for 25 years. The pay was pretty good, but quite literally I hated every nine days out of ten. It was ruining my health, I was drinking way too much, you can pretty much see the picture. I kept thinking that the "next company" would be better, but that was not the case. The final straw was Microsoft: I worked there for nearly five years, and I have never in my life seen a company that degrades and denigrates its employees more. I had enough, and told them to fuck off. I left without even having another job, because I could no longer live with the morons in charge.

There is good news here: After telling MS to FOAD, I went back to college for a Master's degree, something I wanted to do all my life. Today, I've moved out of Seattle and am living in Kuala Lumpur. The pay is nowhere near what I was making before, but for the first time in nearly three decades I honestly enjoy most of the days. I doubt I will make KL home for the rest of my life, but it has gotten me to take the leap and go after something I enjoy rather than whoring myself out for some company I detest.
